data.summary:
Resourceful and technically proficient Workday Integration Developer with over 3 years of experience in enterprise integration, data automation, and database development, including over 2.5 years of current project experience with StratosTech Solutions, a US- based IT services company.
Demonstrates strong expertise in Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, PICOF/PICIT, and Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP), alongside advanced proficiency in Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, and Python scripting for automation.
Adept at designing and deploying integrations, building data pipelines, and collaborating cross -functionally with business and technical teams.
Excelled in prior roles supporting American Express digital banking initiatives by automating core processes, improving security, and ensuring data accuracy.
Continuously enhances skills through cloud certifications and Workday Pro Integrations Certification.
Seeking to contribute value to forward-thinking tech organizations by optimizing integration architecture and streamlining data operations.

responsibilities: Implemented end-to-end Workday HCM to Payroll integration using Workday Studio, Core Connectors, and EIB for ADP payroll, ensuring accurate and timely transfer of employee data.
Developed inbound EIB integrations for worker, job, and compensation data migration during Workday go-live, validating records against legacy HR systems to ensure 100% accuracy.
Built and deployed Benefits integration with third-party vendors, automating eligibility and enrollment data exchange via encrypted SFTP channels.

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Workday Integration Developer / Database Developer
Cognizant Technology Solutions
 08/2022 – 08/2025	 Bangalore, India
Client: StratosTech Solutions | Austin, Texas, USA Project Duration: December 2022 – August 2025
Industry: Technology & IT Services
Core Responsibilities
Understand business requirements and assist in designing Workday integration solutions.
Develop and maintain inbound and outbound integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, and PICOF/PICIT.
Support integration development using Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP APIs).
Implemented end-to-end Workday HCM to Payroll integration using Workday Studio, Core Connectors, and EIB for ADP payroll, ensuring accurate and timely transfer of employee data.
Developed inbound EIB integrations for worker, job, and compensation data migration during Workday go-live, validating records against legacy HR systems to ensure 100% accuracy.
Built and deployed Benefits integration with third-party vendors, automating eligibility and enrollment data exchange via encrypted SFTP channels.
Collaborate with functional teams to gather technical specifications and accurately map data fields.
Monitor integration performance using Workday’s Integration Dashboard and handle exceptions or failures.
Schedule and manage integrations via Workday Integration System Schedules and cron jobs.
Participate actively in the change management process for integration deployments and updates.
Create and maintain technical documentation for all developed integrations.
Provide post-deployment support and troubleshooting for integration-related issues.
Learning & Development
Stay updated on Workday release cycles and integration enhancements.
Participate in team knowledge-sharing sessions and learning initiatives led by senior developers.
Project Name: Sanofi Testing Project
Role: Workday Integration Tester/QA Consultant Duration: February 2025 – August 2025
Core Responsibilities
Reviewed integration requirements and functional specifications to create test scenarios.
Designed and executed test cases for Workday integrations, reports, and calculated fields.
Performed Unit Testing, System Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure data accuracy.
Validated inbound and outbound integrations using EIB, Workday Studio, and Core Connectors.
Monitored integration runs in Sandbox and Production, identifying and logging errors.
Worked closely with developers to verify fixes and retest failed scenarios.
Ensured data integrity between Workday and external systems, like payroll or benefits providers.
Prepared test documentation and reports for stakeholders to track test coverage and results.
Tools Used
Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP), XSLT, XML, JSON, Workday Report Writer, ISU (Integration System User), Business Process Framework, Integration Event Viewer, Workday Test Framework.
Client: American Express (AMEX)
 08/2022 - 12/2022
Enhanced digital banking platforms by developing and automating backend data operations.Designed and
deployed Python scripts to automate daily reporting and operational workflows.
Authored complex SQL queries to manage and validate large datasets across banking platforms.
Automated batch data retrieval and updates using cron job scheduling, reducing manual intervention significantly.
Administered Linux system operations, including user access management and log monitoring.
Collaborated with QA, DevOps, and Backend Engineering teams to build secure and scalable solutions.
